subtitle: Programming II

授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: In this course, students will learn about standard library functions, file input/output, pointers, and structures, which are important when using the C language.
advice:
In this subject, students will study to deepen their knowledge of C language programming.
The learning items are as follows.

- Standard library functions
- File input/output
- Pointers
- Structures

Students will practice using the C language development environment on their PC to deepen their understanding.

requiredKnowledge:
This class assumes that students have already taken "Introduction to Programming" and "Programming I."
Students will practice using their PC and C language development environment.
Students should thoroughly review the C language grammar and how to operate the development environment.

activityGoals.body: Be able to develop programs using your PC, find mistakes in programs, and fix them.
Be able to use the major standard library functions of the C language.
Be able to create swap functions, arithmetic functions, etc., that use pointers.
Be able to define structures and access various types of data.
Be able to create practical programs by reading and writing data from text files, etc.

achievementLevels.ideal: Have a thorough understanding of the basic syntax of the C language, especially pointers, structures, and file input/output, and can create practical programs that combine these.
achievementLevels.standard: Have a general understanding of the basic syntax of the C language, especially pointers, structures, and file input/output, and can create basic programs that combine these.

              In this course, students will learn about standard library functions, file input/output, pointers, and structures, which are important when using the C language.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              In this subject, students will study to deepen their knowledge of C language programming.
The learning items are as follows.

- Standard library functions
- File input/output
- Pointers
- Structures

Students will practice using the C language development environment on their PC to deepen their understanding.
